title: Internal Hom commutes with etale restriction
statement: Let f : Y → X be an etale morphism of schemes, Lambda a commutative ring, and F,G sheaves of Lambda-modules on X_et. There is an isomorphism f^* internalHom(F,G) ≅ internalHom(f^*F,f^*G), with internal Hom for the sheafified objectwise tensor product. No finiteness hypothesis is imposed on F,G or Lambda.

source.place: IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.ihom_unit docstring, local finite presentation argument

proof.text: Identify étale pullback with the localization restriction using Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction. Compute the unit of the restriction/pushforward adjunction sectionwise and verify its tensor and unit identities; these prove that the identification is monoidal. This is the étale specialization of the pro-étale argument in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.UpperLowerStar.InternalHom.

Composition with an étale morphism induces equivalences on every slice, by CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.Over.isEquivalence_post_map_op. Thus the presheaf restriction comparison is invertible by CategoryTheory.isIso_ihomComparison_whiskeringLeft. The sheaf inclusion comparison is invertible by CategoryTheory.Monoidal.Reflective.isIso_ihomComparison. Apply the composition formula for comparison transformations, and reflect isomorphisms through sheafToPresheaf to obtain the comparison for localization restriction.

Transport invertibility through the monoidal pullback/restriction identification, using isIso_ihomComparison_of_iso. Evaluate the comparison transformation at G and use asIso to construct the requested isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: unit compatibility lemmas, monoidal restriction identification, and ProEtale.isIso_ihomComparison_upperStar; adapted to the small étale sites by J1

theorem nonempty_etale_upperStar_ihom_iso (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    (F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj ((ihom F).obj G) ≅
      (ihom ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj F)).obj
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj G))
